semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Dftech specializes in precision cleaning and coating technologies for semiconductor manufacturing, which are essential for maintaining equipment and improving production efficiency.
summary: Dftech is a leading provider of precision cleaning and coating technologies for the semiconductor and LCD manufacturing industries. Established in 2003, the company offers comprehensive solutions from part design to manufacturing, focusing on enhancing productivity and reducing costs for manufacturers.

regional_presence.China: Dftech founded a branch office in China in 2006 to extend its business area.
